notes: This source/test traceability contract covers only explicit non-region object-class attribute publication and subscription state in Umbra's non-installable development profile. It traces the Requirements Lab records that describe per-class declaration state, active/passive subscriptions, and the class-level consequences of an empty or non-empty attribute set. The Lab currently does not export a granular requirement candidate for the preceding available-attribute iff rule or for the 5.3.3(f) pending-acquisition unpublication guard; those extraction omissions are logged separately as RL-012 and RL-014. A separate limited object-instance contract consumes this state for unnamed registration/discovery and snapshots the applicable implicit privilege-to-delete effect. Whole-class declarations, advisory callbacks, full ownership, update-rate enforcement, regions, time ordering, packaging, and evidence promotion remain outside this declaration slice.
